integrity: A self-contained exact computational census with complete reproducible scripts and logs; no independent review, no claimed external mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: Only rational all-smooth cubic pencils in characteristic two over F2; geometric nonrational members may be singular; PGL-orbit equivalence not isomorphism of elliptic fibrations; source priority subject to unindexed catalogues.
title: An exact \(\mathbf F_2\) census of all-smooth pencils of plane cubics
